name: NevronixAI – Digital Humans – Boost Sales, Capture More Leads, and Reduce Support Costs
author: NevronixAI

sections.description:
Boost Sales, Capture More Leads, and Reduce Support Costs with 24/7 AI-Powered Digital Humans.

Engage website visitors in real time with NevronixAI’s lifelike Avatars available 24/7, fluent in 140+ languages, and always ready to assist. Deliver premium customer support, represent your brand with confidence, and drive conversions while cutting operational costs.

NevronixAI Digital Humans can be used for the following purposes:
– Boost Online Sales and capture new leads
– Onboard, support, and educate consumers
– Recommend and upsell products
– Handle customer inquiries and complaints
– Deliver personalized and engaging user experiences
– Capture valuable user insights through targeted conversations
– Customize your own use case by uploading knowledge data to your Digital Human during the setup process at https://nevronix.ai

Getting started is simple:
Create your real-time Digital Human (Avatar). It only takes a few clicks and we offer a FREE Trials.
1) 👉 Click Here — Register & Create Digital Human
2) After creating your Digital Human, copy your unique API URL and paste it into the plugin’s API URL field.
3) Import your website data (including pages, posts, WooCommerce products) automatically by clicking the Sync Website Data button.
4) Choose where you want your Digital Human to appear, then click Save Changes. You’re all set!
Need help? Our team is here for you — completely FREE!

👉 Book a meeting with us

✉️ Or email us at hi@nevronix.ai

🌐 Visit our website: nevronix.ai

This plugin interacts with the following servers to provide the Digital Human functionality:
https://platform.nevronix.ai
sections.faq:
Do I need to register with NevronixAI before adding a Digital Human to my website?

Yes, you must register at www.nevronix.ai and create your Digital Human to obtain the keys necessary for configuration on your website.

Getting started is simple:
Create your real-time Digital Human (Avatar). It only takes a few clicks and we offer FREE Trials.
1) 👉 Click Here — Register & Create Digital Human
2) After creating your Digital Human, copy your unique API URL and paste it into the plugin’s API URL field.
3) Import your website data (including pages, posts, WooCommerce products) automatically by clicking the Sync Website Data button.
4)Choose where you want your Digital Human to appear, then click Save Changes. You’re all set!
Need help? Our team is here for you — completely FREE!

Can I expose my website data, such as product or customer information, to my Digital Human for better customer assistance?

Yes! Version 1.1 introduces automatic sync. Simply click the “Sync Website Data” button in the plugin settings to import your WordPress pages, posts, WooCommerce products, and more directly to your Digital Human.

Can I change the Digital Human avatar and voice?

Yes, during the Digital Human creation process at www.nevronix.ai
, you can select from a variety of avatars and voices to personalize your Digital Human.

What languages are supported?

NevronixAI supports over 140+ different languages and voices. You can select your preferred language(s) as part of the Digital Human creation process at www.nevronix.ai.

Will my Digital Human plugin work without registering at [https://nevronix.ai](https://nevronix.ai/pricing/)?

No, the plugin will not function unless you first register at https://nevronix.ai and obtain the necessary API credentials for configuration.

Can I use a self-hosted LLM?

Yes! You can connect your own Large Language Model to your Digital Human:

  1. Log in to your NevronixAI account
  2. Navigate to My Humans → Edit Your Human → Step 5: Knowledge & Additional Settings
  3. Check “Connect your Digital Human to your Own LLM Solution (Optional)”
  4. Enter your API Key, Host, and Model details
  5. Click -> Next
  6. Click -> Save & Go Live

For implementation guidance, see our GitHub example: https://github.com/NevronixAI/customLLM

Need assistance? Contact us at hi@nevronix.ai for help integrating your LLM.

Can I use a self-hosted TTS (Text-to-Speech)?

Yes! You can integrate your own Text-to-Speech engine:

  1. Log in to your NevronixAI account
  2. Navigate to My Humans → Edit Your Human → Step 4: Choose Language and Voice
  3. In “Text to Speech Provider” select Custom TTS
  4. Enter your API Key, Host, Language and Voice
  5. Click Next
  6. Click Save & Go Live

For implementation guidance, see our GitHub example: https://github.com/NevronixAI/customTTS

Need assistance? Contact us at hi@nevronix.ai for help integrating your TTS solution.

Can I use ElevenLabs voices?

Yes! You can integrate ElevenLabs.

  1. Log in to your NevronixAI account
  2. Navigate to My Humans → Edit Your Human → Step 4: Choose Language and Voice
  3. In “Text to Speech Provider” select ElevenLabs
  4. Enter your API Key, Language and VoiceId
  5. Click Next
  6. Click Save & Go Live

Need assistance? Contact us at hi@nevronix.ai for further help with ElevenLabs integration.

Can I create a Custom Avatar ?

Yes! You can. Contact us at hi@nevronix.ai and we will be happy to help.

Can I clone my voice?

Yes! You can. You can clone your voice using ElevenLabs. Once you clone your voice in Elevenlabs then
1. Log in to your NevronixAI account
2. Navigate to My Humans → Edit Your Human → Step 4: Choose Language and Voice
3. In “Text to Speech Provider” select ElevenLabs
4. Enter your API Key, Language and VoiceId
5. Click Next
6. Click Save & Go Live

Need assistance? Contact us at hi@nevronix.ai for further help with voice cloning
sections.changelog:
1.1

  • Add ability to sync WordPress and WooCommerce content to NevronixAI platform
  • Implement login modal for authentication during sync process
  • Collect pages, posts, products, categories, widgets, and custom post types
  • Add progress indicator and success summary for sync operation
  • Support for Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, and Beaver Builder page builders
  • Include ACF fields and product reviews in data collection

= 1.0
* First Release.
